# Hallucination Hunter

> Claim-by-claim factual verification engine and shared Supabase Postgres fact-check ledger for LLMs (Claude, Antigravity, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, Codex, and custom agents).

## Capabilities

- Breaks LLM responses or passages into standalone atomic claims while keeping exact dates, numbers, versions, and names intact.
- Verifies each claim with strict post-cutoff honesty (`verified`, `unverifiable`, or `false` with a factual correction) and resolves live authoritative web URLs.
- Cross-checks against and writes back to the shared Hallucination Hunter Supabase Postgres database (`analyses` and `claims` tables).
- Returns both structured JSON verdicts and a `markdownReport` block ready to append directly beneath an LLM's answer.

## Endpoints & Protocols

- Web Console: https://hallucination-hunter-five.vercel.app
- REST Verification & DB API: `POST https://hallucination-hunter-five.vercel.app/api/verify`
- Fact-Check Database Search: `GET https://hallucination-hunter-five.vercel.app/api/verify?search=<keyword>`
- Remote MCP Server (Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0): `https://hallucination-hunter-five.vercel.app/api/mcp`
- OpenAPI 3.1 Schema (ChatGPT Custom GPT Actions): https://hallucination-hunter-five.vercel.app/openapi.json
- Agent Skill Repository (`npx skills add`): https://github.com/Sunil56224972/hallucination-Hunter (`skills/hallucination-hunter/SKILL.md`)
- Downloadable Skill Zip (Claude.ai): https://hallucination-hunter-five.vercel.app/assets/hallucination-hunter-skill.zip

## Quick Example (POST /api/verify)

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://hallucination-hunter-five.vercel.app/api/verify \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text":"Python was created by Guido van Rossum in 1991. Python 3.0 was released in 2005.","client":"llm"}'
```
